    "local val = redis.call(\'GET\', KEYS[1]);\nif val then\n return {1, val};\nend\nlocal lockKey = KEYS[1] .. \':lock\';\nlocal acquired = redis.call(\'SET\', lockKey, \'1\', \'NX\', \'PX\', ARGV[1]);\nif acquired then\n return {2, \'LOCKED\'};\nelse\n return {3, \'WAIT\'};\nend\n"
